$comment: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 ComradeArt. SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. One installed-system evidence record. The conditional requirements below are the point of the schema: they encode, structurally, the two relabellings the adversarial tests refuse — a VM run presented as physical evidence, and a PASS with nothing measured behind it.
title: Bunny OS installed-system qualification record

evidenceId.$comment: Produced only by release.installed.evidence_id; a record minting its own identifier format is a record nothing can index.

recoveryArtifactDigest.$comment: Optional because a scenario that never touches recovery media has nothing honest to put here; absent and wrong stay distinguishable.

environment.$comment: A qemu-kvm record can never satisfy a physical prerequisite. The two values are not grades of the same evidence; they are different claims, and the physical one carries a mandatory device identity (see the allOf below).

hardwareRecord.$comment: Names the hardware qualification record the physical machine was described in. Required whenever environment is physical: a physical claim without a device identity is indistinguishable from a VM run relabelled.

secureBootState.$comment: not-tested is recorded, never inferred: 'disabled' and 'nobody looked' must stay distinguishable.

tpmState.$comment: swtpm evidence must never satisfy a physical-TPM requirement. A software TPM proves the code path; only physical-tpm2 proves the device interaction, and the gate that consumes this field must treat them as different claims.

scenarioVersion.$comment: A scenario change is a new context; a record naming another scenarioVersion is stale, whatever its result.

collectionCommand.$comment: How the file was produced, so a reviewer can reproduce the observation instead of trusting the label on it.

limitations.$comment: What this record deliberately does not claim, recorded so the boundary of the evidence travels with the evidence.

allOf.$comment: The 'VM evidence labelled physical' refusal: a physical record must name its hardware record.
A PASS with no assertions is screenshot-only evidence: something looked right, nothing was measured. Refused structurally so no importer needs to remember to check.
